clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, a great growth was torn from Oakenscowl, the corrupted timberling by Lake Al'Ameth. The tumor bears witness to sickness spreading among the creatures there.

Oakenscowl lurks in a cavern near Lake Al'Ameth's southern bank. Once a noble timberling elder, the creature has fallen to a vile affliction. A huge growth poisoned Oakenscowl, warped its behavior, and spread taint through the surrounding wildlife. The tumor was severed to end the beast's rampage and give local researchers a chance to examine the blight. They hope to learn how the malady took root in the boughs of the newly grown World Tree.
